_doc: Optional alternate search keywords per theme. Used by build_theme_lineage.py to UNION additional canonical-name variants into the seed pool (#274 — was: "fallback when primary returns 0", which missed cases like "Flash Attention" vs the one-word "FlashAttention" canonical paper). Aliases are merged in parallel with the primary keyword, then the unified pool is re-ranked by citation count and capped at seeds_count. Keys are lower-cased theme strings (the same normalisation discover_seeds applies internally).
